title: SaC standard library compilation benchmark — thesis snapshot
description:
Benchmark harness and raw measurement data for the standard-library compilation experiment in the MSc thesis A Novel Type System for Rank-Polymorphic Array Languages (Radboud University, 2026).

32 runs per compiler, all completed without failure. Includes full per-run records: wall-clock time, peak resident set size, CPU time and SLURM job IDs. Measured against SaC standard library commit 9afffd46db51.

Measured on the Radboud University SLURM cluster, node cn99: Intel Xeon E5-2630 v3 @ 2.40 GHz, 4 CPUs and 14 G per task, partition cncz, Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS (kernel 6.17.0-14-generic), gcc 13.3.0. No warmup; each SLURM task is an independent cold run.

The compiler versions benchmarked are archived separately at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22060662.
